entities.summary: The Rohilla dynasty was a dynasty that ruled over much of northwestern Uttar Pradesh, initially as the Kingdom of Rohilkhand and later as the Princely State of Rampur. At the height of their power, the dynasty ruled over Rohilkhand, and launched invasions into the kingdoms of Kumaon and Garhwal.
